name: input

frames.best_why: The email field is focused with a blue glow under the cursor and a visible caret.

tagline: Dark text fields with a blue glow that follows the mouse.
summary: A dark sign-up card with two labelled text fields. Hovering a field lights a soft blue radial glow under the cursor that trails as it moves, and focusing adds a thin ring for typing.
appearance: A dark sign-up card with the bold title Welcome to StashUI, a grey subtitle and two labelled fields stacked vertically. Each field is a rounded slate bar with faint placeholder text, and the hovered one carries a small blue glow under the cursor.
behaviour: Moving the pointer over a field lights a blue radial glow that follows the cursor and fades at the edges; leaving removes it. Focusing a field adds a thin grey ring and a caret for typing.
demo_content: Heading Welcome to StashUI, fields Email and Full name with placeholders you@example.com and Maya Chen.
search_phrases: input with a glow that follows the mouse
dark text field with blue spotlight
form field with cursor glow effect
email input for dark signup card
input that lights up on hover
text box with radial hover highlight
use_when: A dark sign-up or login form where small feedback makes plain text fields feel responsive.
avoid_when: Touch and keyboard use: the glow only follows a mouse pointer.
customise: Any native input attributes pass through alongside className; the glow radius, blue colour and ring styles are fixed in the source.
weight_why: One motion template glow on a single input; nothing loops.

a11y.note: The glow follows a mouse only and reduced-motion is not considered; labels and ids must be supplied by the caller.

issues: The glow is invisible on touch and to keyboard users.
The component ships no label or id, so accessible names depend on the caller.
The blue glow can wash out the placeholder text under the cursor.
polish_why: Crisp dark form and a subtle pointer glow; the effect does little for touch or keyboard.
title: Radial Glow Input
